info.name: Petstore API Tests
info.description:
API tests for the Swagger Petstore ([https://petstore.swagger.io/v2](https://petstore.swagger.io/v2)).

Covers:

- CRUD: create, read, update and delete a pet
    
- Find pets by status
    
- Negative tests: malformed JSON body, invalid pet ID, deleted pet returns 404
    

Run the folders in order (CRUD, FindByStatus, Negative tests). Select the PetStore environment first, with baseUrl set to [https://petstore.swagger.io/v2](https://petstore.swagger.io/v2).

item.name: Verify pet status is sold (R after U)
